# Synapse artwork

The README uses `synapse-hero-v2.png`: a 2172 × 724 opaque PNG generated on 2026-11-03 with the built-in Imagegen tool. The new identity uses a cobalt-blue connection mark, flowing ivory forms and clear glass on a light background. It represents connecting independent application and assistant contexts; it is original brand artwork, not a product screenshot, protocol diagram or claim of offline inference.

`project-card.webp` is the matching compact 960 × 540 portfolio image. Its English/German descriptions, alternative text and generation prompt live in `project-card.json`. The earlier `synapse-hero.png` is retained as legacy artwork. The repository's MIT license applies to these project assets.

## Legacy generation prompt

```text
Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally art-directed hero image for the GitHub README of Synapse, a TypeScript library connecting local applications to installed AI CLIs. This is original brand artwork, not a screenshot or a literal technical diagram. Format: very wide landscape banner, ideally 2400 by 800 pixels, 3:1 ratio, all important content comfortably inside a 7% safe margin. Main visual idea: a sculptural, precision-engineered synapse junction, connecting several distinct terminal-like modules with delicate luminous signal paths. One coherent, memorable central junction, four modular ports, clear feeling of software infrastructure and controlled connection. Premium editorial 3D still life with smoked translucent glass, matte ceramic, anodized metal, tiny machined details and restrained luminous traces; bespoke composition, not generic AI clip art. Deep ink/navy background with a subtle tactile grain; warm ivory typography; electric tangerine and soft mint accents. Large crisp tasteful wordmark on the left reads exactly 'Synapse' in a strong contemporary sans-serif with generous spacing, clearly readable at GitHub README width. Sculptural modules and elegant light traces occupy the right half, balanced negative space, dramatic yet restrained studio lighting, high contrast, refined technical aesthetic. Small terminal glyphs such as >_ may appear on the physical modules, but no other words or small labels. No third-party logos, no robot, no brain illustration, no infinity symbol, no people, no purple gradient blobs, no padlocks, no badges, no claims about local inference or privacy, no watermark. It should look like the confident cover of a serious open-source infrastructure project, not a consumer chatbot advertisement.
```

Embed the asset with a repository-relative path and meaningful alternative text. It should remain legible at ordinary GitHub README width without making essential information available only in the image.

## Current hero generation prompt

```text
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset: NEW Synapse README hero, wide 3:1 landscape, target 2400x800.
Reference image: the supplied card is the new Synapse visual identity and MUST be preserved faithfully. Convert that identity into a wide README banner. The prior terminal-box/machine/industrial identity is rejected and must not appear.
LEFT THIRD: the exact same new cobalt-blue branching/converging connection mark from the reference, with the large exact black word "Synapse" below. Same confident sans-serif character. Generous white margin and a readable brand lockup.
RIGHT TWO THIRDS: expand the same smooth ivory ceramic ribbons and clear glass layers, converging around a precise cobalt-blue connection at their meeting point. Elegant, airy and abstract, meaningful negative space, warm white studio background and soft grounded shadows. Gentle wide flowing geometry, not a device or diagram. Keep every essential element within a 7% safe margin, although long sculptural ribbons may flow gracefully toward the edge.
Only text: "Synapse". No tagline, other prose or badges. No terminals, command glyphs, computers, boxes, wires, pipes, glowing chambers, machinery, brain, robot, padlock, neon, orange/mint palette, dark background or watermarks.
This is original brand artwork expressing connecting independent application and assistant contexts, not a product screenshot or a promise of offline inference. Match the reference's mark, color and material identity exactly, adapted solely to the wider format.
```
